items.title: 26.5 Ghair tehleel pazeer polymers ka masla (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Plastic, jaise poly(ethene), duniya mein sab se zyada istemal hone wala polymer material hai.

blocks.title: Non-degradable polymers
blocks.text: Riwayati (conventional) polymers non-degradable hain, yani yeh saada aur ghair zehreele (non-toxic) compounds mein toot nahi sakte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke non-degradable polymers "saada, non-toxic compounds mein toot sakte hain". Baat ulti hai: non-degradable ka matlab hai ke yeh is tarah toot NAHI sakte; isi liye mahol mein bache rehte hain.

Isi wajah se phenkne ke baad yeh mahol (environment) ke liye museebat ban jate hain. Yeh polymers daryaon aur samandar ke paani, mitti aur jaandaron ke qudrati ghar (habitats) ka hissa ban jate hain. Is liye scientists ab degradable (tootne wale) polymers bana rahe hain. Plastic ka kachra ya to zameen mein dabaya jata hai, ya jahan municipality (shehri safai) ka nizam achha nahi, wahan khuli hawa mein phenk diya jata hai.

items: Yeh mahol mein bohat lamba arsa rehte hain, is liye landfills (kachra dabane ki jagahon), samandaron aur qudrati ilaqon mein jama ho kar mustaqil pollution (aaloodgi) paida karte hain.
Yeh gal-sar (decompose) nahi hote, is liye landfills mein bohat jagah gherte hain. Aabadi barhne ke saath naye landfills ke liye jagah milna mushkil ho jata hai.

Jaanwar, khaas tor par samandari jaandaar, plastic ko khana samajh lete hain; is se dam ghut'ta hai, andar zakhm hote hain ya woh bhooke mar jate hain. Jaanwar plastic ke kachre mein phans bhi jate hain.

Waqt ke saath plastic ke bare tukre bohat chhote zarron mein toot jate hain jinhein microplastics kehte hain. Yeh har jagah phail kar mitti, paani aur hawa ko bhi aaloodah karte hain, food chain (khurak ki zanjeer) mein dakhil ho jate hain aur insani sehat ko nuqsan pohancha sakte hain.

blocks.text: Is liye polymers ki do bari qismein banane ki zaroorat paish aayi: biodegradable aur photodegradable polymers.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Poly(alkene)s, jaise poly(ethene), chemically inert (be-asar) hain, kyun ke in ki chains mein sirf mazboot C-C aur C-H bonds hain; in mein koi aisa polar group nahi jis par paani ya bacteria hamla kar sakein. Isi liye inhein biodegrade karna mushkil hai.

blocks.prompt: Poly(alkene)s ka biodegrade hona itna mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: In mein sirf mazboot, non-polar C-C aur C-H bonds hain; ester ya amide jaise links nahi jin ko hydrolysis se tora ja sake.

items: Non-degradable plastics saada compounds mein nahi toot'te; mahol mein lamba arsa rehte hain.
Nuqsanat: landfill ki jagah, jaanwaron ko nuqsan, microplastics aur food chain.
